root_cause.text: The Octeontx2-af driver dereferences `rvu->fwdata` without a NULL pointer check, causing a kernel panic on boards booted without the MAC block (CGX/RPM) because the firmware data structure is not mapped.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit NULL checks for `rvu->fwdata` before accessing its members (e.g., `if (rvu->fwdata && rvu->fwdata->channel_data.valid)` in `rvu_sdp_init` and a guard `if (!rvu->fwdata)` in `rvu_mbox_handler_cgx_set_link_mode`). The Oops trace shows the crash at `rvu_sdp_init`, and the CVE description confirms that accessing `fwdata` on boards without the MAC block leads to kernel panics.
